title: Session Prep, Run Sheet, GM Screen & Live Reference Workspace
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Session Prep, Run Sheet, GM Screen and Live Reference Workspace preparation over the MAS-01..15 foundations while preserving canonical Session, GM/live runtime, Visibility, Knowledge and Action/Event owner authority and keeping prepared session-reference tooling distinct from live session state or runtime mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Session Prep, Run Sheet, GM Screen and Live Reference Workspace structures inside MAS without turning prepared reference tooling into canonical Session state, GM/runtime state, player visibility/knowledge state or live Action/Event truth.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically prepare session-reference structures over completed MAS foundations with explicit canonical owner references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving Session, GM/runtime, Visibility, Knowledge and Action/Event authority and never treating prepared session-reference tooling as proof of live session occurrence or mutation.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-15 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

P9-06-016 authoritative Session command handling retained canonical live Session command, revision and event authority; realtime-session retained SessionCommand/SessionEvent semantics; GM/live runtime owners retained runtime mutation/adjudication authority; A9 Visibility retained authorization-before-projection; Knowledge/KFR retained knowledge/familiarity authority; Action/Event/runtime owners retained occurrence truth.

Prepared Session Prep, Run Sheet, GM Screen and Live Reference Workspace structures never proved a Session started, a Session revision advanced, a run-sheet entry executed, GM/runtime state changed, player visibility/knowledge changed or an Action/Event occurred.

MAS-16 consumed explicit MAS-15 prepared references plus validated Session, GmRuntime, Visibility, Knowledge and ActionEvent owner bindings; unresolved and owner-domain-mismatched references fail closed.
Production code remained frozen after minimum GREEN c528e3eb808ede98fd9fb721e5fcfe315fd3393f; the proof layer added governance/compliance/verifier surfaces only.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-16.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-16, including current MSLR/MSWI planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-17 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-18+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-16 is closed. MAS-17 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
